featured_reviews.name: Shivani Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
The experience was extremely disappointing, especially considering the amount we paid. We were charged ₹7,100 for two people for what turned out to be a barely one-and-a-half-hour workshop with almost no explanation of the technique or process.

No proper details were shared about the type of ceramic we were working with, how it should be handled, or the fundamentals of the craft. We were simply handed a lump of clay with minimal guidance, which made the session feel rushed and poorly planned.

The most frustrating part came afterward. We were initially informed that the plates would be ready in 30–40 days after firing and glazing. However, we received a call within just 15 days saying the plates were ready and would be couriered to us. Since we were not in Mumbai at the time, we requested them to hold the plates so we could collect them in person once we returned. Shockingly, we were told they did not have shelf space to store two plates.

This is quite unreasonable, especially for a studio charging close to ₹4,000 per person for a short workshop. If you’re positioning yourself as a premium service, basic considerations like storage and flexibility should not be an issue.

To make matters worse, the plates were couriered to us anyway and we were asked to bear the courier charges ourselves.

Overall, the experience did not justify the price at all. If a premium fee is being charged, the service should reflect that. Unfortunately, this was not the case. I would not recommend this place - there are far better and more genuine pottery studios available elsewhere.

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Malhotra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve always known Sunaina to be a talented potter. When I asked her how she got into it and became so good, she told me to come for a class. I also wanted to try something new, so I went. It ended up being one of those experiences that quietly stays with you.

She makes the whole thing feel easy from the moment you walk in. There’s no awkwardness, no pressure to be good, no sense that you’re behind. She explains things clearly, shows you what to do, and then lets you get into it at your own pace. If something goes wrong (and things will go wrong because this is a craft) she’s right there. Calm, practical, encouraging. She doesn’t make a big deal out of it or make you feel conscious.

What I really appreciated is how she gets you to relax into the process. I tend to overthink and try to control outcomes, and pottery doesn’t work like that. She keeps reminding you to loosen your grip, trust your hands, and stay with the clay. That shift alone makes the class worth it

The environment she creates is warm and comfortable and you will definitely feel safe experimenting. You feel okay messing up and like you’re actually learning something instead of performing.

If you’re even slightly curious, just go for it. Sunaina is a FANTASTIC teacher and makes it approachable and really grounding. I’m definitely going back. And I understand why she’s so in love with this craft.
